players.product: optical components for transceivers & CPO (FAU, lens assemblies, isolators)

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record, online call; board secretary and deputy general manager Chen Kairong): supply of key bottleneck materials for active optical devices has improved since the end of Q2 compared with H1, and the company expects the positive effect on results to be released gradually over the coming quarters. The passive optical device business keeps developing well on continued industry demand growth, and the company keeps expanding capacity in line with customer needs. On new product directions shown at the OCP summit, more products are moving toward multi-channel, high-integration designs, which management says plays to its process strengths in high-precision passive devices, optical coupling, precision manufacturing and large-scale quality delivery. The future share of silicon photonics versus EML in optical engines depends on cost, performance, reliability and customer adoption pace; its capacity expansion is focused on CPO and NPO, whose prospects it views positively, and it will keep expanding to meet customer demand.
